questions.question: Six students Tanya, Roop, Johar, Soma, Manvi and Deep are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Soma is sitting second to the right of Deep. Soma is an immediate neighbour of both Manvi and Johar. Roop is sitting second to the left of Johar. Deep is an immediate neighbour of both Johar and Roop. Who is the immediate neighbour of Tanya and Deep?
questions.solution:
**Given : **

 
• Six students Tanya, Roop, Johar, Soma, Manvi and Deep
 
• All of them are sitting around a circular table
 
• All of them are facing the centre.

**Explanation :**

1) Soma is sitting second to the right of Deep.

2) Soma is an immediate neighbour of both Manvi and Johar.

As position of Manvi and Johar with respect to Soma is not known yet therefore, there are two possible positions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0fba6030d2c3bb6c58ed5a38982182c419b99c52c035e5b2d53b3ea5136f227.png] 

3) Roop is sitting second to the left of Johar.

4) Deep is an immediate neighbour of both Johar and Roop.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3763909c538edf505c3c7da8defacea6383d049dcf52620c2add48554e3a924b.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Roop is the immediate neighbour of Tanya and Deep.

Hence, **"Roop"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: Six people A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. C is sitting second to the left of E. B is the immediate neighbour of E and F. A is sitting second to the right of B. Who is sitting between B and A when considered from the right of B?
questions.solution:
**Given :** Six people A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

**Explanation : **

1) C is sitting second to the left of E.

2) B is the immediate neighbour of E and F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d8abb2274279080ab5668d360765945ed07859df1cb202fa89123f86aefc3396.png] 

3) A is sitting second to the right of B.

After positioning A only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21b6188327bb999cc3806293960f33b0ede2d0a54f2970eaf929a8ca3de4a14a.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement F is sitting between B and A when considered from the right of B.

Hence, **"F"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some chairs are bedsheets.

All cots are chairs.

All pillows are bedsheets.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some pillows are chairs.

II. Some cots are bedsheets.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5d61fb0c1cb669c2425f95bc35be9db342754939549164cba8ffbfdc374422e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some pillows are chairs - **Does not follow** (As, some chairs are bedsheets, all cots are chairs and all pillows are bedsheets. So, it is possible but not definitely true).

II. Some cots are bedsheets - **Does not follow** (As, some chairs are bedsheets, all cots are chairs and all pillows are bedsheets. So, it is possible but not definitely true).

So, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Neither conclusion I nor II follows**".
